subject: Measure which communication forms actually reduce the proof frontier per resource unit

body.text: Connect model-usage accounting back to the coordination fabric itself. For mesh-origin work that already has lineage, derive non-monetary coordination-efficiency observations: provider tokens and wall time consumed per accepted evidence edge, solved invariant, or measured frontier reduction; fraction of work that ended completed/advanced/blocked; and replay/retry waste. Compare communication forms already exercised in this run: prose proof challenge, semantic-ref rendezvous, executable baton, parity/ref-only challenge, and direct state-derived work. Do not count tokens as dollars and do not invent token usage for external-chatgpt events where it is unavailable. Do not use the metric as authority. Use it as an adaptive-density prior for choosing the next communication encoding: if executable/ref-only batons yield equal or better accepted proof with materially less provider usage, prefer them; if prose carries unique information, retain it. This makes the collaboration self-optimizing instead of merely more verbose.
